Now is the opportunity to utilize conditional logic; before diving in, let’s define a new character column for each data frame

We’ll create a for loop while using if/else logic to classify the type of blood pressure measurements after receiving the treatment in the first group:

for (i in 1:20){
  if (updated_bp_data_1$post_bp_1[i] <= 120){
    updated_bp_data_1$status[i] = 'optimal'
  } else if ((updated_bp_data_1$post_bp_1[i] > 120) & (updated_bp_data_1$post_bp_1[i] <= 130)){
    updated_bp_data_1$status[i] = 'borderline'
  } else if (updated_bp_data_1$post_bp_1[i] > 130){
    updated_bp_data_1$status[i] = 'high'
  }
}

  } else if ((updated_bp_data_2$post_bp_2[i] > 120) & (updated_bp_data_2$post_bp_2[i] <= 130)){

  } else if (updated_bp_data_2$post_bp_2[i] > 130){
    updated_bp_data_2$status[i] = 'high'
  }
